{{Quote|For my new gallery's debut show, I contrast the sterility of urban life with the pure, unmediated vigor of Nature.|Bab Esrus, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HWNGS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Help With Naboo Gallery Show}}</ref>}}
'''Bab Esrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sculptor/Legends|biosculptor]] who lived on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bab Esrus owned art galleries on Naboo where she exposed her work. As a biosculptor, she used to perform sculptures from the body of dead creatures. For this purpose, she often paid [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] to sacrifice wild animals for her. Thus, she recommended non-invasive termination to maintain the integrity and beauty of the specimens.<ref name="SWG:HWNGS" /> 

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Esrus was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] where she hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to perform several tasks. First, the individual was sent to retrieve [[DNA/Legends|genetic material]] — pigmentation-production chromosomes of the common [[capper spineflap]] — from the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Dega Coronis]]. Later, the spacer escorted another scientist, [[Pol Teiroburc]], near Moenia and protected him from a [[Mott/Legends|mott bull]] attack. Eventually, the adventurer delivered a cage containing a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] with multicolored [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to a noble known as [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Ilsan Raetura]]. During the delivery, they were attacked by a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] but the spacer was able to eliminate him.<ref name="SWG:BE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I plan to join the ranks of the many artisans and entertainers on scenic Naboo. Its cities offer many sidewalk cafes where I can watch the world go by, and perhaps entice shock-wounded players to let me serenade them on my kloo horn. (I feel sure those players could not imagine a more pleasant pastime.) In the artists' retreat of Moenia, I shall consort with noted playwright Randanthus Mandelatara and biosculptor Bab Esrus.|Allen Varney (SWG writer)|<ref name="ign">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2003/04/18/star-wars-galaxies-qa-3-2|text=Star Wars Galaxies Q&A #3|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20230620191309}}</ref>}}
Bab Esrus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Bab Esrus could be found in the city of Moenia where she gave three completable missions.<ref name="SWG:BE" /> However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:BE" /><ref name="NabooMap">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=55618.html|text=Attach to the Labeled Naboo Map: All Static missions for Naboo}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> Bab Esrus was eventually removed from the game by its developers.
